newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.

text.p: Millfeed prices were mostly steady Wednesday but with a negative bias, U.S. millfeed dealers said.
"We have had steady demand for the last six weeks," a Minneapolis dealer said. "Runtimes are still good and the markets are fairly steady. But I think the trend is down."
A St Louis dealer agreed. "The St Louis market feels all right. But I guess with corn fading and all other competing ingredients slipping, I think millfeeds will work its way a little bit lower."
There was also some interest in feed for the catfish farms in Mississippi.Business in that part of the country has improved, the St Louis dealer added.
The Memorial Day holiday was coming up and the expected cutbacks in flour mill runtimes should keep a firmer tone to the market, a Buffalo dealer said.
In the Southeast, merchants were trying to cover their needs because of anticipated reduced runtimes this month, a Carolinas dealer said.
A Chattanooga dealer said the Ohio Valley area seems to be in good shape. "If you need feed for this week, things are real in St Louis, Chicago and Toledo," he said.
